entries.zh: 报喜赏钱；贺喜时的赏赐（据西语栏 albricias 异体推断）——汉字「威實」义不明，释义存疑
entries.en: albridas, apparent variant of albricias: tip or gratuity given for good news or a service; the Chinese gloss is unresolved
entries.notes: 西语「Al bridas」疑为 albricias 之古异体 albridas（b/r 易位系稿写常见），而汉字「威實」义不可考，四栏不能互证，故降为低置信。

entries.zh: 贺喜；报喜（时的赏钱、谢礼）
entries.en: albricias: gratuity or tip given for good news, good service or on festive occasions; congratulatory reward

entries.zh: 媒人；撮合者、拉皮条者
entries.en: alcahuete: matchmaker; go-between or pander

entries.zh: 牵线做媒、居间撮合；拉皮条
entries.en: alcahuete: to act as go-between or pander; to join parties together, matchmake
entries.notes: 末字「縩」为疑难字（糸+蔡/糸+祭之形，字形未定）；义据西语 alcahuete 与「牽門」定为居间撮合。

entries.zh: 内通；暗中牵线、私相串通
entries.en: alcahuete: to liaise or connive from within; to act as secret go-between

entries.zh: 官；官员、长官
entries.en: alcayde: commandant, governor or warden; official, officer

entries.zh: 狱官；典狱长、狱吏之长
entries.en: warden of the prison (alcayde de la carcel); alcayde mayor, chief warden or fortress commandant

entries.zh: 狱卒；地狱之卒（喻鬼卒），如衙役警吏
entries.en: jailer, turnkey; warden of hell (a devil), like an alguazil (constable)
entries.notes: 四栏语义互证清晰（狱卒/alcayde del infierno），但 M 栏一声调号污损（T99），依规程降为低置信。

entries.zh: 攀；攀上、向上攀取
entries.en: to reach up high; to climb or pull oneself up

entries.zh: 扳下来；把高处之物扳落下来
entries.en: to bring it down, pull down from on high

entries.zh: 攀摘；采摘（果实）
entries.en: to reach and pluck (fruit); pick

entries.zh: 求得所图；得到所求之物（汉字有疑难标记）
entries.en: to obtain what one seeks or aims at
entries.notes: 汉字录作「浔/潯（氵+尋）」存疑；其读音与第19条「得」字之读法全同，义取「得所求」。

entries.zh: 得力；得到助力、获人相助（首字有疑难标记）
entries.en: to obtain favor and help; to gain assistance
entries.notes: 首字与第12条同、录作「浔/潯」存疑；与西语「alcançar fabores, aiuda（求得恩惠与帮助）」相合，解为「得力」。

entries.zh: 扑灭、扑灭（火）；剿灭——西语栏「对清账目」义与此不合，释义存疑
entries.en: to extinguish, put out, exterminate (per Chinese gloss 撲滅); the Spanish headword reads 'to reach or settle in the account' — senses conflict
entries.notes: 西语栏「alcançar en la quenta」与汉栏「撲滅」语义冲突，疑稿面串行错位；zh 依 H/R 定为扑灭义，待核。

entries.zh: 到手；如愿获得
entries.en: to obtain what one desires; to come to hand

entries.zh: 赶走；追逐而逐之
entries.en: to chase away by pursuit; to overtake and drive off
entries.notes: M 栏首音节声调号污损（T99），依规程降为低置信；「趕走」追赶逐走之义与西语追及义相合，语义本身可定。

entries.zh: 赶着；赶去做、急忙去做
entries.en: to hurry to do, hasten; to catch up with someone in order to do something
entries.notes: M 栏一声调号污损（T99），依规程降为低置信；「趕着」赶做之义据 H/L 可定。

entries.zh: 应；应承所求、应付账款
entries.en: to answer or comply with what is asked; to pay what is due

entries.zh: 应得；理当获得
entries.en: to be entitled to; deservedly obtain

entries.zh: 求得；恳求而得、祈求而得
entries.en: to obtain by asking or begging; to get through entreaty
